transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling Cymbal Telecom Business Support. My name is Jessica. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Hi Jessica. This is Thomas Anderson from Pinnacle Real Estate. I got an email saying our automatic payment failed for our internet service.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can certainly look into that for you, Mr. Anderson. To access your account, could you please provide your Customer ID?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Sure, it's CUST-2009.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. And for security, could you please verify the 6-digit PIN associated with the account?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect, thank you for verifying. Just give me one moment to pull up the billing details for Pinnacle Real Estate.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, Mr. Anderson, I have your account here. I can see the automatic payment attempt on the 15th for one hundred ninety-nine dollars for the Business Fiber Gigabit plan was indeed declined.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Right. I figured it was our corporate card. It expired at the end of last month and I just got the new one. So I need to pay that balance and then update the card for future payments.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Not a problem at all. We can certainly get that sorted out for you right now. The total outstanding balance is one hundred ninety-nine dollars. I can take the new card information over the phone if you're ready.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, let's do it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Great. I am now placing this call into our secure, encrypted payment system. Please tell me the full 16-digit card number when you're ready.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. And the expiration date?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: It's... uh... August of 2028. So 08/28.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: 08/28. Got it. And the three-digit C-V-V code from the back of the card?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And is the billing address for this card the same as the service address we have on file for Pinnacle Real Estate?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, it is.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect. Okay, Mr. Anderson, I am submitting the payment now for one hundred ninety-nine dollars. This can take up to sixty seconds to communicate with the bank, so please bear with me for just a moment.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: ...Still processing... almost there... Okay! Excellent. The payment was approved. Your account is now fully paid and in good standing. Your confirmation number for today's payment is 7-4-B-2-9-1-C.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Great, glad that's done. So now for the autopay...

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Exactly. Would you like me to enroll this same card, the one ending in 6677, as your new default payment method for automatic billing?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, absolutely. Please do.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay. I'm accessing your autopay settings now... removing the old expired card from the profile... and now I am adding the new card. This will just take a moment.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Alright, Mr. Anderson, thank you for your patience. It's all set. The new card is saved and you are now re-enrolled in automatic payments with Cymbal Telecom.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Fantastic. That's a relief. So we're all good for next month's bill?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, you are all set. Your next scheduled payment will be automatically charged on or around the 15th of next month. No further action is needed from your side.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Perfect. That was everything I needed. Thank you for your help, Jessica.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It was my pleasure, Mr. Anderson. I'm happy we could get your account squared away. Was there anything else at all I could assist you with today?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Nope, that's it for me. Thanks again.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You're very welcome. Thank you for choosing Cymbal Telecom. We appreciate your business. Have a wonderful afternoon.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: You too. Goodbye.
